sections.content: Date functions handle timestamps: NOW()/CURRENT_TIMESTAMP for now, DATE_TRUNC for bucketing (day/hour), INTERVAL for arithmetic, EXTRACT for parts (year, month).
Store timestamps in UTC (TIMESTAMPTZ), convert for display in app layer, and index date columns you range-filter.
Key points: date math differs per dialect (Postgres intervals vs MySQL DATE_ADD), always specify timezones, and "today" boundaries are a classic bug source.

sections.codeExample:
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('day', created_at) AS day, COUNT(*)
FROM events GROUP BY 1;
